acceptance_criteria.statement: Tasker phone fields are excluded from all customer-facing payloads and UI contracts.
Customer phone is masked until selected tasker accepts booking and paid lead unlock succeeds in paid phases.
Exact address reads are blocked until allowed lifecycle/payment milestone and unauthorized requests return
Message pipeline flags phone-sharing patterns and emits admin alert events; Phase 0-1 actions remain advisory.
Booking confirmation and dispute intake explicitly surface no-recourse notice for off-platform arrangements.
Messaging payloads preserve in-app-first communication policy and hide tasker contact in all phases.
